g.text: N08 | Layers 5 to 9 pass the conditional rescue gate

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52636d

g.text: Intended-rule code correct / 16. Every block and all five donor conditions are shown.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364b56

g.text: Original: 16/16. Fixed layer 0 corruption and its identity: 0/16. Every condition retains 4/4 JSON controls.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364b56

g.text: Eligibility: same-rule rescue at least 12; opposite-rule at most 4; recipient at least 12; clean same-rule at least 14.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364b56

g.text: The frozen rule selects the fewest layers, then earliest start. The highest rescue count does not determine selection.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364b56

g.text: 660 audited records, including 60 carried references. Same development prompts with nuisance-name replications. Zero training.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364b56

g.text: A whole-block rescue of an induced error. Sparse neuron meaning, necessity and improvement of the original model remain unestablished.
